content.class.runner.blurb: 管事的跑腿，赶集前一天被派到大街上，看看一切是否都准备好了。
content.class.runner.kit.0.name: 跑腿的木杖
content.class.runner.name: 管事的跑腿
content.fx.market-day.done.0.narrate: 阿什福德准备好赶集了。
content.fx.trig.the-high-street.0.narrate: 这是阿什福德的大街。管事要你在赶集前把街上每一处都看一遍：喷泉小院、铁匠铺、集市棚，最后是他自己的家。
content.obj.market-day.the-fountain.hint: 喷泉小院就是街边那片敞开的小广场，中间有座喷泉。
content.obj.market-day.the-fountain.title: 去喷泉小院看看
content.obj.market-day.the-house.hint: 管事的家在街对面，橡木门朝着大街。
content.obj.market-day.the-house.title: 走到管事的家
content.obj.market-day.the-market.hint: 集市棚在街的前头，四根柱子撑着一个屋顶。
content.obj.market-day.the-market.title: 走到集市棚底下
content.obj.market-day.the-smithy.hint: 铁匠铺的门面越过柜台敞开着，门就在柜台旁边。
content.obj.market-day.the-smithy.title: 走进铁匠铺
content.quest.market-day.goal: 沿大街走一趟，把赶集要用的地方都看一遍：喷泉小院、铁匠铺的门面、集市棚，最后是管事的家。
content.world.outro: 集市都布置好了，这条街就等着赶集了。
content.world.title: 敞开的院子

source.class.runner.blurb: The steward's runner, sent down the high street the day before market day to see that everything is ready.
source.class.runner.kit.0.name: Runner's staff
source.class.runner.name: Steward's Runner
source.fx.market-day.done.0.narrate: Ashford is ready for market day.
source.fx.trig.the-high-street.0.narrate: Ashford's high street. The steward wants every place on it looked at before market day: the court, the smith, the market, and his own house last.
source.obj.market-day.the-fountain.hint: The fountain court is the open square off the street, with the fountain in its middle.
source.obj.market-day.the-fountain.title: Look in at the fountain court
source.obj.market-day.the-house.hint: The steward's house is across the street, its oak door on the street.
source.obj.market-day.the-house.title: Reach the steward's house
source.obj.market-day.the-market.hint: The covered market stands further along the street, a roof on four posts.
source.obj.market-day.the-market.title: Walk under the covered market
source.obj.market-day.the-smithy.hint: The smith's front is open over the counter. The door is beside it.
source.obj.market-day.the-smithy.title: Step inside the smithy
source.quest.market-day.goal: Walk the high street and look in on every place market day needs: the fountain court, the smith's front, the covered market, and last the steward's house.
source.world.outro: The fair is set, and the street is ready for market day.
source.world.title: The Open Yard
